gloss: to show one's skill; to demonstrate one's ability; to display one's talents

definitions.gloss: to show one's skill; to demonstrate one's ability; to display one's talents
definitions.explanation: To actively demonstrate or exercise one's skills, especially in a situation where those abilities can be fully utilized. Often used when someone gets an opportunity to use their expertise.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{腕|うで}を{振|ふ}るって⟦もてなした→もてなす：10635_motenasu⟧。
examples.english: I showcased my cooking skills to entertain the guests.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{腕|うで}を{振|ふ}るう⟦{機会|きかい}→機会：01302_kikai⟧だ。
examples.english: Today is a chance to show what I can do.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{思|おも}う{存分|ぞんぶん}→思う存分：22310_omouzonbun⟧{腕|うで}を{振|ふ}るいたい。
examples.english: I want to fully demonstrate my abilities in the new project.

notes:
IDIOM STRUCTURE:
⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧ (arm; skill) + ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ + ⟦{振|ふ}るう→振るう：12793_furuu⟧ (to wield; to exercise)

⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧ here means skill/ability, not literally the arm. ⟦{振|ふ}るう→振るう：12793_furuu⟧ means to wield or exercise something actively.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{腕|うで}を{振|ふ}るう - to show off cooking skills
- {腕|うで}を{振|ふ}るう⟦{機会|きかい}→機会：01302_kikai⟧ - opportunity to show one's skill
- {腕|うで}を{振|ふ}るう⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧ - place to demonstrate ability
- ⟦{思|おも}う{存分|ぞんぶん}→思う存分：22310_omouzonbun⟧{腕|うで}を{振|ふ}るう - to fully exercise one's skills

USAGE:
Positive expression. Implies:
- Having genuine skill to demonstrate
- Having an appropriate opportunity
- Enthusiasm to show one's abilities
- Active engagement, not just passive display

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧ - to show one's skill
- ⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発揮|はっき}する→発揮する：17267_hakkisuru⟧ - to demonstrate one's ability
- ⟦{手腕|しゅわん}→手腕：07466_shuwan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発揮|はっき}する→発揮する：17267_hakkisuru⟧ - to display one's capability
- ⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発揮|はっき}する→発揮する：17267_hakkisuru⟧ - to show one's talent

RELATED WORDS:
⟦{腕|うで}を{磨|みが}く→腕を磨く：07453_udewomigaku⟧ - to hone one's skills (complementary - first you polish, then you show)
